name: Vienna Comic Con
blurb: Austria's biggest pop-culture and gaming event, with film and TV actors, comic creators and cosplay competitions at Messe Wien.

picks: Daredevil, Men In Black, Full Metal Jacket
Superman & Lois, The Walking Dead, Band Of Brothers
German fantasy novelist, Die Elfen series
Comic inker: Batman, Silver Surfer, New Avengers
Comics writer: Scalped, Thor, Star Wars

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown and date block: '21. - November 22, 2026 MESSE WIEN VIECC® 2026' and 'DATE 21. - November 22, 2026 Opening hours: Saturday: 10:00-20:00 Sunday: 10:00-18:00'; guests-2026 page titled 'Guests 2026 - VIECC® Vienna Comic Con'.

notes: Refresh 2026-10-07: added DoctorFroid, a new card under Content Creators on the guests-2026 page (photo of two people); all earlier picks are still listed. Organizer confirmed via the site's own Impressum: 'Austrian Exhibition Experts GmbH ... operates VIECC Vienna Comic Con under license from Wiener Messe und Congress GmbH' (the batch note's guess of ReedPop was wrong and dropped). Cards on /guests-2026/ show only names, no descriptor text, for everyone except the Entertainment Stars & Actors (whose franchise credits appear on the homepage itself). For the Artists And Writers row I filled in 'known for' from independent confirmation only where I was confident (Gruber, Hennen = established novelists; Koch, Aaron, Asrar, Capezzone = established comic creators; Dave Lung confirmed via his own VIECC portfolio page and DeviantArt as a Batman/Silver Surfer/New Avengers inker; Stephanie Gladden as a Disney-side animation visual-development artist). Mathias Kollros is listed as a comic artist on lower confidence, and Sam Feuerbach / T.S. Organ could not be identified beyond appearing in this same 'Artists and Writers' row, so they're categorised as comics on a section-based best guess, flagged here as uncertain rather than left out, since they are a confirmed real booked guest just not one I could research further within budget. Cover uses the official 'VIECC 2025 Entertainment' promo graphic (hero:0) instead of og:image, which is a generic, differently-dated contact-page photo. 2026-10-08 refresh: added Krystl Cosplay, Tingilya Cosplay and Benjamin Munz (the only new cards whose link is under /en/2026/; name-only cards, Munz left cat other with no known-for). The other new cards in the grid link to /en/2023/, /en/2024/ or /en/2025/ guest pages (past years) and were skipped. Removed DoctorFroid: today its cards link only to /en/2024/ and /en/2025/ pages, so nothing presents it for 2026.
